header

sections · 0.2.4 · aj-s-header

The website's pinned header on mobile and tablet (the quiet navbar): the masthead above the destinations, pinned over the page's reader. Reading away from the journal's end, it compacts: the masthead clears, the destinations rise to the top and the date settles into their slot; back at the end it expands again. Desktop keeps the masthead and its sticky column, never this header.
